name: Seared Strip Steak with West African Tomato Salsa, Peanuts & Cauliflower Rice (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head cauliflower
1 red bell pepper
1 tomato
½ jalapeño pepper
1 (6 oz) pkg blueberries

instructions.primary_message: Cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer cauliflower rice to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower rice halfway through, until tender and golden, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb striploin (New York strip) steak
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and seed bell pepper. Slice half lengthwise into thin strips, place on another plate, and set aside. Small dice remaining bell pepper and place in the reserved bowl.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl, along with oil, vinegar, and spices, then stir to combine the spicy salsa. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp red wine vinegar
¼ tsp thyme, dried
14 tsp curry powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Toast naan if desired, then spread with peanut butter and cut into wedges. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 flatbread or naan
1 tbsp natural peanut butter

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak into strips. Roughly chop peanuts.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of steak, peanut butter naan, bell pepper strips, and blueberries between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide cauliflower rice and remaining steak between plates, then top steak with salsa and peanuts. Enjoy!
